entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.code_description: CHAPTER 13 - LAC; GUMS, RESINS AND OTHER VEGETABLE SAPS AND EXTRACTS
entries.comment: Foodstuffs for human and animal consumption, live animals, seeds, plants, additives normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs. Excl. beverages and water, this does not apply to selected drinks (milk and liquid milk products, plant-based milk alternatives, even if they contain added sugar or other sweetener, additive or other food, provided they retain the essential character of such beverages).

entries.comment:
Food for human consumption, excluding food supplied for catering, is taxed at 0% (exempt with credit) (part 2).  

The above exemption does not apply to items classified under the following subheadings in the First Schedule of the Import Duties Act:

(1) 1207.30.90; 1207.99.91.00; 1209.30.00.00; 1209.99.10; 1209.99.91.00; 1209.99.99.00; 1211.90.30

(2) 1301.10.00.00; 1302.11.00; 1302.14.00; 1302.19.05; 1302.19.30; 1302.19.91; 1302.19.98; 1302.20.10; 1302.20.90

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.code_description: CHAPTER 13 - LAC; GUMS, RESINS AND OTHER VEGETABLE SAPS AND EXTRACTS
entries.comment:
- Foodstuffs referred to in article 2 in regulation EC no 178/2002 are subject to reduced VAT rate, with the exception for tap water and certain alcoholic beverages, see chapter 9 section 3 in the Swedish VAT Act.
- Goods with CN code 2203 can be subject to reduced VAT rate provided that the alcohol content is maximum 3.5 volume percent. Goods with CN code 28-29, 3201-3206, 3301-3302, 3501-3505, 3507 can be subject to reduced VAT rate if they constitute food additives.

entries.comment: All foodstuffs except the selected items taxed at 5 % rate and selected foods with increased sugar and salt content. These are goods primarily intended for human consumption or for the production of goods suitable for human consumption.
